reg [1:0] next_state; // To store the next state of the traffic
reg [2:0] light; // To store the output light state

    if (reset) begin
        state <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        state <= next_state;
    end
end

// Determine next states based on the current state transitions 
always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        0: begin 
            next_state = 1;
        end
        1: begin 
            next_state = 2;
        end
        2: begin 
            next_state = 3;
        end
        default: next_state = 0;
    endcase
end

// Determine the light outputs based on the current state
always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        0: light = 3'b110; // Red and No duplicates
        1: light = 3'b011; // Red and Amber
        2: light = 3'b001; // Green
        3: light = 3'b101; // Amber and Red
        
        default: light = 3'b000;
    endcase
end

endmodule
